newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah steady in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah steady in late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was steady against the dollar in slow late trading on Tuesday.
One Japanese bank dealer said the market was mixed, with the dollar trending to the left in the morning and firming in the afternoon along with the fluctuating money supply.

"There is no clear trend in the market. It's probably due to the liquidity that the rupiah is stable," he said, adding that the rupiah was firm despite minor disruptions reported during the campaign for the May 29 general election.
Spot rupiah was at 2,424.60/25.00 at 0900 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,424.50/25.5o.
Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,423.25/23.75 and 2,422.0/23.0, respectively.
Dealers said liquidity supply remained volatile, with overnight rates rising briefly to a high of 17.5 percent in the afternoon before settling at 14.0/15.0 percent.

They said the dollar-rupiah rate was in line with the fluctuating money market. Tom/next swaps rose to 1.35 before cooling down to 1.25 points as the market eased. "It's still very much driven by liquidity," one dealer said.
Overnight swaps were last at 0.9/1.0. The market will be closed on Thursday for a public holiday.
